description: This file defines the BuzzLikeDao class, a Data Access Object responsible for managing 'like' entities on shares and comments in a social feature of the HRM system. It includes methods for persisting, deleting, retrieving, and counting likes, as well as building queries with filtering and pagination.

classes.name: BuzzLikeDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class that manages database operations for BuzzLike entities related to shares and comments, including CRUD operations, filtering, and counting.

methods.name: saveBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Persists a BuzzLikeOnShare entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: saveBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Persists a BuzzLikeOnComment entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: deleteBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Deletes a like on a share for a given share ID and employee number, returning the number of affected records.

methods.name: deleteBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Deletes a like on a comment for a given comment ID and employee number, returning the number of affected records.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareByShareIdAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzLikeOnShare entity based on share ID and employee number.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentByShareIdAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzLikeOnComment entity based on comment ID and employee number.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of BuzzLikeOnShare entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareCount
methods.description: Returns the count of BuzzLikeOnShare entities matching the search filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of BuzzLikeOnComment entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentCount
methods.description: Returns the count of BuzzLikeOnComment entities matching the search filter parameters.
